title: Generation of data on discontinuous manifolds via continuous stochastic non-invertible networks
abstract: arXiv:2112.09646v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The generation of discontinuous distributions is a difficult task for most known frameworks such as generative autoencoders and generative adversarial networks. Generative non-invertible models are unable to accurately generate such distributions, require long training and often are subject to mode collapse. Variational autoencoders (VAEs), which are based on the idea of keeping the latent space to be Gaussian for the sake of a simple sampling, allow an accurate reconstruction, while they experience significant limitations at generation task. In this work, instead of trying to keep the latent space to be Gaussian, we use a pre-trained contrastive encoder to obtain a clustered latent space. Then, for each cluster, representing a unimodal submanifold, we train a dedicated low complexity network to generate this submanifold from the Gaussian distribution. translated_title: 基于连续随机不可逆网络的不连续流形数据生成
translated_abstract: 对于大多数已知框架（如生成自编码器和生成对抗网络）而言，生成不连续分布是一项困难的任务。生成式不可逆模型无法准确生成此类分布，需要较长的训练时间，且经常出现模式崩溃（mode collapse）问题。变分自编码器（VAE）基于保持潜空间为高斯分布以便于简单采样的思想，虽然能够实现准确的重构，但在生成任务上存在显著的局限性。在本工作中，我们不再试图保持潜空间为高斯分布，而是使用预训练的对比编码器来获得聚类的潜空间。然后，对于代表单峰子流形的每个聚类，我们训练一个专用的低复杂度网络，从高斯分布生成该子流形。所提出的框架基于互信息的 信息论公式（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新框架：利用预训练对比编码器获得聚类潜空间，并为每个代表单峰子流形的聚类训练专用低复杂度网络，从而有效生成不连续分布的数据，克服了VAE和GAN等传统方法在此类任务上的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel framework that uses a pre-trained contrastive encoder to obtain a clustered latent space and trains dedicated low-complexity networks for each cluster representing a unimodal submanifold, enabling effective generation of discontinuous distributions that traditional methods like VAEs and GANs struggle with.
